title: SAMPLE: Design-Build New Community-Based Outpatient Clinic, St. Cloud, MN
agency: VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.VETERANS AFFAIRS, DEPARTMENT OF.NETWORK CONTRACT OFFICE 23 (sample)
description: ILLUSTRATIVE SAMPLE (not a real notice). The Department of Veterans Affairs intends to award a single firm-fixed-price design-build contract for a new Community-Based Outpatient Clinic (CBOC) of approximately 45,000 gross square feet, including primary care, mental health, imaging, laboratory draw stations, and 220 parking spaces. Construction is anticipated to begin in spring 2027 with a 20-month performance period. Magnitude of construction is between $25,000,000 and $50,000,000.
